fact: Car 87 left the track at turn 1 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 30 was overtaking Car 87 on the inside of Turn 1. Car 30 was well ahead of the mirror of Car 87 at the apex of the corner. Car 87 left the track and took the escape road, rejoining ahead of Car 30 at Turn 3, thereby gaining an advantage. Car 87 did not voluntarily give the position back. Car 30 subsequently overtook Car 87 on the following lap. We accordingly imposed a 10 second time penalty for leaving the track and gaining a lasting advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
